//: Standalone type-check for @watermark/core (Epic #1549, Phase 1). The package is runtime-agnostic: React-free and DOM-free (no `document`/`window`/`sessionStorage`) so it imports from the Astro site AND the Cloudflare Pages Functions (Workers, under nodejs_compat) AND vitest. `lib` is plain ES2023 (NOT `DOM`); `types:["node"]` supplies the Node/build-time surface the domain logic legitimately uses — node: builtins (bundle.ts's fs/async_hooks) plus the web-standard globals Node implements (crypto/URL/TextEncoder/btoa/atob), all of which Workers also provide. Excluding `DOM` is what enforces the boundary: a stray `sessionStorage`/`document` fails here (that's why browser-only `auth.ts` stays in the site). `import.meta.env` (Vite) is declared in src/vite-env-shim.d.ts and `astro:content` (lazily imported by src/stories.ts) in src/astro-content-shim.d.ts; the site/Vite supply the real ones. `npm run check` in web/ runs this via `tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json`.
